feature: STRATA_PREFILL_NATIVE_XMX=1, FP16/native-BF16 input and FP32 accumulator/output
operator_protocol: Independent A/B/A/B/A processes; 3 warmups, median of 7 batches x 3 full engine calls. Same128MiB external workspace and all128 pool. N17 excluded before measurement; |adjacent baseline drift|<=3%.
operator_precision: Random tests permit max_abs<=0.005 on eligible XMX shapes and eight independent CPU FP64 samples per case. Fallbacks byte-exact. Full dyadic benchmark outputs match FP32 baseline and CPU reference exactly.
operator_baseline_note: Both frozen arms retain the older conversion/GEMM host waits. Current live source differs only by removing those two waits, verified before build; that preexisting change is preserved and is not part of this experiment.

selection.rule: Both rounds and dtypes: >=3 nonmicro cases, |baseline drift|<=3%, median gain>=3%, no eligible gain below -3%. Random parity uses 0.005; dyadic benchmark outputs are exact.

Select all shapes first, otherwise T<=64 only. Both rounds and both dtypes require >=3 nonmicro cases with absolute paired-baseline drift <=3%, median gain >=3%, no eligible loss below -3%. Eligible direct-XMX outputs must match the previously measured full FP32 dyadic output hashes.

frozen_model_vs_half1024.scope: IQ2_XS Code256, cold A/B/A, greedy, max32 outputs, same 128MiB prefill workspace, 4191 slots /5760MiB, INT8 KV, all128 pool, no prompt reuse; single-prompt prefill/functional screen, not broad quality or sustained decode performance

final_combined_source_model_vs_fp32.scope: Current widening waits preserved; default-off direct XMX. Same-binary FP32/XMX/FP32 Code256 screen, greedy max32 outputs, 128MiB workspace, fixed4191 cache slots, all128 pool.

limits: One Code256 prompt, cold processes with existing driver cache, greedy max32 outputs; not broad quality or sustained decode testing.
Isolated relink of current GEMM and matching128MiB prefill with frozen common engine dependencies; not a clean full-worktree build or comparison to installed production EXE.
Prefill gains apply after existing dequantization; no fused quantized XMX or MMVQ decode change.
